title: Read-only roles: the brief names the denied forms, and a few plain read-only commands are allowed
lead: Every read-only brief (reviewer, gate, architect, spec check, UI pass) states the command forms that are denied, so roles stop trying them; the implementer brief says socket-bound tests may fail inside its sandbox and that ork's round check is the evidence; and the read-only allowlist gains a few plain read-only commands.
findings_note: 2026-11-18 to 11-20: ten tool-feedback slices from reviewer, gate and UI passes (S465, S469, S471, S472, S478, S479, S481, S485, S486, S488) report denied commands: shell variables for the worktree path, `; echo exit=$?`, env-prefixed `go test`, `slicer COMMAND --help`, `slicer ai relay`, `rg` on test globs, `ls` and `git ls-files` in the role's own TMPDIR, `git init` for a fixture, and implementers reporting socket tests that fail only in their sandbox. Owner decision adj 519 (`roles.read-only-allowlist-batch` = brief-first, 2026-11-20).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Roles keep spending calls on forms the approval rules deny, then file the denial as tool feedback: ten slices in three days. The cloud UI pass brief already states its denied forms (`internal/engine/brief.go:289`) and the claude-local brief its tool rules (`internal/engine/brief.go:116`); reviewer, gate, architect and spec check briefs do not (`internal/engine/brief.go:308` covers only some forms). adj 519 chooses to state the denied forms first and add only plain read-only commands, not shell variables, `;` chains or env prefixes.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/perm.go:25-37` (`LocalReadOnlyAllowlist`: the new entries)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:82` (`deniedCommandForms`: shared sentence)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:118` (`BuildBrief`: claude-local tool wording)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:275-334` (`doneWhen`: shared denied forms and implementer socket note)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go` (new tests and existing snapshots)
- `internal/engine/perm_test.go`
- `internal/agent/claude/args_test.go` (only if a test pins the full read-only list)
- `internal/daemon/runner_test.go:279` (`localReadOnlyTools`: pinned read-only list used by launcher and argument tests; fix-round check finding)
- `docs/design.md:2439-2465` (Permissions: read-only allowlist and brief rules, adj 519)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestReadOnlyAllowlistBatch` in `internal/engine/perm_test.go`: `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist` contains the five decided entries; excludes rg and shell variables, chains and env prefixes.
- `TestReadOnlyBriefsNameTheDeniedForms` in `internal/engine/brief_test.go`: `BuildBrief` emits one shared line naming all denied forms and literal absolute paths with git -C and go -C for every read-only role, including reviewer, gate, architect and spec check on cloud Claude; keep local tool wording consistent.
- `TestImplementerBriefNotesSandboxSocketTests` in `internal/engine/brief_test.go`: `BuildBrief` says socket-bound tests may fail inside the sandbox, report them as sandbox-limited, and use ork round check as evidence.
- Update any test that pins the full read-only list: `localReadOnlyTools` in `internal/daemon/runner_test.go:279` feeds `TestLocalDispatcherUsesLaunchersAndRowFlags`, `TestReadOnlyRoleOnCloudClaudeGetsTheReadOnlyList`, `TestUIPassStillGetsItsWriteRule`, `TestClaudeRunnerGivesOnlyTheCloudUIPassAWriteDir`, `TestClaudeProgressPermissionIsOneAbsoluteFile` and `TestClaudeReadOnlyRoleArguments`. No such pin was found in `internal/agent/claude/args_test.go`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests and see each red for the stated reason.
2. Add the five entries to `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist`. Do not add rg (adj 520: `rg --pre` runs a program, as adj 457 found; roles use the Grep tool), shell variables, `;` chains, env prefixes or `git init` (adj 519).
3. One shared denied-forms sentence used by every read-only brief, replacing the partial line at `internal/engine/brief.go:308`; keep the UI pass and claude-local wording consistent with it.
4. The implementer brief's sandbox note for socket-bound tests.
5. Docs: `docs/design.md`, citing adj 519. Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S505 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A read-only role may run slicer COMMAND --help, slicer ai relay, ls and git ls-files as plain commands; rg stays out (adj 520).
- No new entry allows a shell variable, a ; chain or an env prefix.
- Every read-only brief names the denied forms; the implementer brief carries the sandbox socket note.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/engine -run 'TestReadOnlyAllowlistBatch|TestReadOnlyBriefsNameTheDeniedForms|TestImplementerBriefNotesSandboxSocketTests' -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "Read-only briefs name the denied forms; a few plain read-only commands are allowed".
